_doc: WB Gamification glossary. Every translation uses these renderings; see docs/translation-standard.md in the wbcom-i18n-ai repo. Renderings follow the vocabulary WordPress core, BuddyPress and bbPress already use in each language. Change a rendering here, then run the tool with --review-all for that locale.
brief: WB Gamification is a gamification plugin for WordPress, BuddyPress and BuddyNext communities. Members earn points, badges and levels, see leaderboards, challenges, streaks and kudos, and spend points in a Redemption Store. Audiences: site admins (wp-admin), members (front-end blocks, Hub), and emails.

points.meaning: the currency members earn for actions; the site owner can have several point types

badge.meaning: a visible award a member earns for a milestone or action

level.meaning: a named milestone reached when a member's points pass a threshold

leaderboard.meaning: the ranking of members by points

rank.meaning: a member's place on a leaderboard (1st, 2nd, ...)

challenge.meaning: a goal a member works toward for a reward (points or a badge)

community challenge.meaning: a shared goal the whole community works toward together

streak.meaning: consecutive days a member has kept doing an action, such as logging in

kudos.meaning: a peer-to-peer shout-out one member sends another, often with a few points

gamification hub.meaning: the member dashboard that gathers points, level, badges, challenges, leaderboard and kudos

redemption store.meaning: the shop where members spend points on rewards

reward.meaning: an item in the Redemption Store a member can spend points on

redeem.meaning: to spend points on a reward in the Redemption Store

cohort.meaning: a group of members of similar standing who compete together in a league

league.meaning: a weekly competition tier members are placed in, like a Duolingo league

personal record.meaning: a member's best points total for a day, week or month

year recap.meaning: the year-in-review card of a member's highlights (points, badges, kudos)

earning guide.meaning: the page that shows members how they can earn points on this site

award.meaning: as a verb: to grant points or a badge; as a noun: that grant

action.meaning: a tracked event that can award points, such as posting or completing a course

member.meaning: a registered person taking part in the community

activity.meaning: a BuddyPress activity-stream item, or a row in the member's points history

space.meaning: a BuddyNext community area, like a group (owner-renamable on BuddyNext)

course.meaning: an LMS course (LearnDash, LifterLMS, Tutor LMS, Learnomy)

webhook.meaning: an outbound HTTP callback that notifies an external service of an event

API key.meaning: a secret token a remote app uses to call the plugin REST API

point type.meaning: one of the point currencies on the site (Points, Coins, Karma, ...)

multiplier.meaning: a factor that scales points awarded for an action

daily bonus.meaning: points granted for logging in today, often rising with the login streak
